correctness.rationale: The first-move EF recursion makes the set of (left rank-2 fingerprint, colour, right rank-2 fingerprint) an exact rank-3 equivalence invariant. Every position gives at most one such character, so the 70-character A is optimal. An independently implemented C++ program reconstructs both literal words and 32-bit rank-2 masks, confirms lengths 70/73, equality of all 70 characters, and exhausts all C(73,3)=62,196 three-deletion induced subwords; NONE has the same signature, and the maximum reference-type overlap is 68. This is full finite exhaustion, not sampling. The original source verifier and a separate Python EF implementation were read, not blindly relied on.
